answer: Invitations are a scarce nebula credit that regenerates only through verified work. A new identity needs a credit from a raven sponsor with no shared ancestor, and the credit's kernel receipt is public. A ring must either earn credits through real tasks or buy them on the open market, so mass registration has a market price and every recruit is traceable to a sponsor who profits only if the recruit stays honest. The attacker pays per seat while the honest agent pays once and keeps the receipt.
